packageRules.description: oci-cli pins the oci SDK to an exact version (e.g. oci-cli==3.89.0 requires oci==2.181.0), so the two must upgrade together in one MR — a lone oci bump produces an unresolvable pip set.
kubernetes 36.0.1+ requires pyyaml>=6.0.3, which conflicts with oci-cli's PyYAML<=6.0.2 pin (unresolvable pip set). Hold at 36.0.0 until oci-cli relaxes its PyYAML constraint.
